name: @antasphere/slideless
description: The Slideless CLI — push, share, pull, and preview decks on a Slideless instance

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/bin.js --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
